comparison.note: Split structural vs text comparison. Unlike the dividers, p58's ground is a full building photograph, so the only region flat and dark in BOTH the source and the clean template is the upper-right corner right of the building and below the top-right accent curve; that block is the structural gate (frame + dark ground + registration line up). The TEXT masks are informational only: the source overlays a licensed display serif (the italic stat figures and the 'union' accent word) not bundled yet, plus the building photo the template does not reproduce, so those regions differ by design.
